What are Dehydrated Onion Flakes?

Dehydrated onion flakes are fresh onions that have been sliced and dried at controlled temperatures to remove moisture while preserving their natural flavour, colour, and nutritional value. The result is a lightweight, shelf-stable ingredient that rehydrates quickly and delivers the same taste profile as freshly chopped onions — without the peeling, chopping, or spoilage risk.

India is one of the world's largest producers of dehydrated onion products, with Nasik in Maharashtra being the primary growing region. Nasik red onions are globally recognised for their strong pungency, deep colour, and high dry matter content — making them ideal for dehydration. Kartari Exim sources directly from Nasik farms, ensuring consistent quality and competitive pricing for bulk buyers.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are dehydrated onion flakes used for?

Dehydrated onion flakes are used in soups, sauces, seasonings, instant noodles, snack foods, ready-to-eat meals, and spice blends. They rehydrate quickly and deliver the same flavor as fresh onions with a much longer shelf life.

What is the shelf life of your dehydrated onion flakes?

Our dehydrated onion flakes have a shelf life of 12–24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, in sealed packaging.

Are your onion flakes free from preservatives?

Yes — our dehydrated onion flakes are 100% natural, free from artificial preservatives, colours, and additives. Only fresh red onions are used.

What packaging options are available?

We supply in 10kg, 15kg, and 25kg laminated/poly bags for bulk buyers. Custom packaging is available as per buyer requirements.

Which countries do you export dehydrated onion flakes to?

We export to buyers across the Middle East, Southeast Asia, East Africa, and South Asia. We handle all export documentation and shipping from Pune, India.

Do you provide samples before bulk orders?

Yes, we can arrange samples for quality testing and verification before you confirm a bulk order.
